### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are identified for the fix preserving nested X.509 v3 extensions during Python client imports. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #19896 by preserving nested STIX 2.1 X.509 v3 extensions during Python client imports, including re-imports of certificates exported by OpenCTI. **Changes:** - Reads all 16 extension fields from `x509_v3_extensions`, while preserving precedence for existing top-level fields. - Adds unit tests for nested imports, flat compatibility, precedence, and missing extensions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `client-python/​tests/​01-unit/​entity/​test_x509_v3_extensions.py` | Adds regression tests for extension import behavior. | | `client-python/​pycti/​entities/​opencti_stix_cyber_observable.py` | Combines nested and flat extension values for certificate creation. |
Review effort: Balanced
